paper.title_en: Status of the S-DALINAC with focus on ERL operation
paper.abstract_en: The S-DALINAC is a thrice-recirculating electron acceler- ator at Technische Universität Darmstadt. It can be operated as an energy-recovery LINAC (ERL) besides the conven- tional acceleration scheme serving various nuclear-physics experiments. One-turn and two-turn energy recovery was achieved at the S-DALINAC. A study on the three-turn ERL mode was conducted. A setup for laser Compton backscat- tering is under commissioning and will be introduced. This contribution will give an overview of the facility with a focus on its ERL activities.
